tools.title: List catalogue entries

tools.description: Launch a decoy from a catalogue entry. The sandbox starts pending and a host agent brings it up; poll get_sandbox. Egress is always deny-by-default. Draft entries need allow_draft and the decoys:elevate scope; deprecated and Docker-runtime entries are refused. Agent caps: lifetime, creates per hour and live sandboxes are limited. Needs decoys:write and decoys:read.

allow_draft.description: Launch a draft entry. Refused unless the token holds decoys:elevate.

idempotency_key.description: Retries with the same key return the original sandbox.

lifetime_seconds.description: After this the sandbox is rotated away.
